inventory: Production Game, Vendor, FoodItem, and Review rows for NBA and NHL season 2026. Read-only.

method.venueScope: Distinct venueId values on Game rows where league is NBA or NHL and season is 2026.
method.homeVsSpecial: A venue is a normal home arena when it is the plurality non-neutral site for at least one (league, home team). Every other scheduled building is special/neutral.
method.headlineCsv: Active items whose customCategoryLabel is Headline Item, Local Partner, Drinks/Social, Dietary/Value, or Seafood. Those labels match the league headline-CSV importer.
method.structuredImport: Active items with no headline category label.
method.vendorAsItem: Normalized item name equals normalized vendor name.
method.publicReview: Review.status is ACTIVE and isTestReview is false.

coverage.STRONG: Normal home, 30+ active items, 20+ structured items, vendor-as-item under 40%, specific location on at least half.
coverage.SUSPICIOUS: Added when the menu is entirely headline-CSV, vendor-as-item is at least 40%, specific location is under 50%, or an item is a bundle of several generic foods.
coverage.EVENT-SPECIFIC / PENDING: Not a plurality home arena for any 2026–27 NBA or NHL club.

researchPriority.HIGH: Normal home and EMPTY or THIN.
researchPriority.MEDIUM: Normal home and GOOD, including GOOD + SUSPICIOUS.
researchPriority.LOW: Normal home and STRONG without a SUSPICIOUS flag.

reviews.note: Hidden and isTestReview rows are excluded from the public counts.
